scope: Release unreachable component callbacks from document-lifetime script entries. Independent runtime correction; React projection reassessment remains unfinished.

implementation.nativeMechanisms: Native load/error events and shared script promises remain document-owned. WeakRef subscribers and a module-owned FinalizationRegistry release unreachable instance callbacks.
implementation.remainingGap: A document-lifetime entry previously kept every callback owner alive after its handle became unreachable. Disconnection alone cannot release ownership because retained disconnected hosts still read shared status.
implementation.compatibility: Preserve the existing Set<Binding> shared document-manager shape. Retained handles own their bindings; disconnected status remains current and automatic handlers retain existing connection guards.

proof.ownershipBefore: The disconnected owner remains alive after native GC with strong entry subscriptions.
proof.ownershipAfter: The owner is collected with weak subscribers. Retained disconnected hosts continue to read pending/error status and reconnect normally.

focusedPrimary.coverage: 22 head tests plus2 complete runtime-size report tests.

size.meaning: Exact measured baselines, no extra allowance. No runtime latency or general memory benchmark claim.

review.mode: One bounded inline correctness and simplification pass; follow-up limited to the measured size mismatch from the first gate.

limits: React projection listener amplification and retained synthetic event ancestry remain unresolved. Separate strict regression fixtures are not included in this change.
Full SDK/Looma release qualification and publication remain pending.
The full native C# renderer objective remains unfinished.
